analyzed_vuln.description: Heap out-of-bounds read in the kCommandPredict path of UnpredictICC: it decodes `num` from attacker-controlled command bytes and allocates `shuffled` with size `num`, then unconditionally copies `num` bytes from `enc[pos + i]` (line ~287) after checking only `CheckOutOfBounds(pos, num, size)`. This bound check uses the full input `size`, but command parsing is limited by `commands_end`; thus malformed input can make `pos + num` exceed available payload bytes for this command stream, causing read past the input buffer.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In icc_codec_fuzzer, when `read` mode is selected (first byte 0), fuzz data is passed directly to `UnpredictICC(data, size, &result)`. A crafted compressed ICC stream that reaches command `kCommandPredict` and sets a large/invalid `num` relative to remaining bytes at `pos` triggers the copy loop `shuffled[i] = enc[pos + i]` to read beyond the heap allocation backing fuzzer input. The PoC does exactly this and crashes at icc_codec.cc:287.
